title: Dread Warren round 3: three new versions of every improve take
desc: J rated v2.0107 on the site (Hunter and Weaver KEEP, handed off; 11 IMPROVE, 3 DROP) and picked "Hand off + improve all". Three new versions (a/b/c) of each IMPROVE take: Broodlings, Dread Phantom (five poses each), the Matron chitin and hourglass (four poses each), Lights out the scream and the shell opens, the funnel hollow and the crevice. All turn. Ceiling walking still on hold.

takes.name: Broodlings: plate, dimmed
takes.facts: from W2a1; the same plate build with the glow turned right down, so the black core leads and only eyes burn; every pose turns: walking (feet lifting in turn), clinging to a wall, dropped on its thread, rearing to strike, dead on its back
takes.cam3p: Cam W2a1a Broodlings: plate, dimmed

takes.name: Broodlings: plate, glass belly

takes.facts: from W3c1; almost no light at all: her eyes, her lantern abdomen and eight pairs of eyes; your ring a spark

takes.name: Funnel hollow: deep
takes.facts: from W4b; one more step down, a bigger and denser funnel web (36 spokes) into a deeper nest hole

takes.name: Funnel hollow: deep lips
